results.title: We've Tried 5 Different Slack Alternatives & Here's Our Conclusion | Rocket.Chat
results.content:
## Why to look for a Slack alternative?

Slack was one of the first team collaboration tools to gain prominence in the segment, back in 2014. The platform caught on quickly between business and non-business organizations, which used Slack as a team messaging app. Slack was acquired by Salesforce in 2021 and even though the news has been received with significant surprise by the community, the company hasn’t been very popular with investors for some time.

According to Morgan Stanley analysts, large companies had been choosing Slack alternatives and the massive demand for team collaboration tools in 2020 made Slack’s stock drop around 28%. [...] ### 3. Mattermost

Available in Linux, Windows, MacOS, Android and iOS, this chat app is a team collaboration tool that differentiates itself mainly in terms of data protection. As they state in their manifesto, the developers created this platform to distance themselves from SaaS chat apps.

Mattermost is a pretty good match for large companies’ requirements and, just like Slack, it works for all sorts of industries and teams. It can be self-hosted or cloud-based and it’s very flexible. When compared to Slack, the most significant difference here is in terms of security. [...] There has never been so much talk about team collaboration software as nowadays. The world is witnessing a new working model and improving productivity while working hybridly has become high priority. Among so many options, we've noticed that organizations aren’t necessarily looking for Slack. Check out why companies choose Slack alternatives.

With this in mind, we decided to test these alternatives as team communication tools and help you make the best choice for your company.

## Why to look for a Slack alternative?

results.title: 11 Best Slack Alternatives for Team Collaboration | RingCentral UK Blog
results.content:
While slack offers a cost effective, reliable platform for online team chat, not all users have been satisfied with the functionality of the platform. As remote and hybrid teams become increasingly commonplace, finding a comprehensive, easy to use platform with a holistic range of features has become more important for many. 

What’s more, as Slack went public, and shifted to focus more on the enterprise market, smaller teams, start-ups or those with more unique communications needs have been on the lookout for an alternative platform. [...] RingCentral Video App

### RingCentral

RingCentral’s comprehensive collaboration platform offers a free trial. A popular Slack alternative for those looking for an open source, customisable platform, RingCentral’s wide range of features include audio calls and video calling, online chat, file sharing, screen sharing and task management features to allow teams to stay connected and keep on top of their workload. Available as an app on iOS and Android as well as Windows and Mac, users wanting to avoid downloading the app can access the platform via a web browser.  

### Google Chat [...] ## Why Seek Slack Alternatives?

While Slack might be great for online team collaboration, themed threads and direct and group messaging, it may fall short in some areas. For some businesses, for example, if your organisation requires reliable and secure VoIP services, project management capabilities, file sharing and storage as well as the core team chat functionality, shopping around for an all-in-one, unified platform might be a more cost-effective option.
